http://www.highlandmountain.com/
									Highland Mountain Bike Park, located in Northfield, New Hampshire, USA, was founded in 2003. It bills itself as "America's Bike Park" and as a park 100% dedicated to mountain biking. However, its security lapses led to the compromise of customer and employee data, including contracts, and the leak of all accounting records and invoices.

https://www.assiniboinedentalgroup.com/
									Assiniboine Dental Group is a private dental practice in Winnipeg, Manitoba, operating as a "trustee." It is required to securely store patients' personal health information in accordance with the province's Personal Health Information Protection Act (PHIA). However, due to negligence in security, dental records and payment information (patient names, contact information, treatment history, and insurance/financial transaction information) were compromised and are being offered to your attention.

Hitech Group (HaiTai Group) Quick Info:

Headquarters: Mumbai
Founded: 1991, by Ashwin Dani (late, co-founder and former vice-chairman of Asian Paints)
Type: Indian diversified business group with multiple companies under the "Hitech" brand, over 1000 employees, operating at 15 locations in India, also has a DSIR (Department of Scientific and Industrial Research) certified tech center
Main Activities:
Hard Plastic Packaging (core business, operated through Hitech Corporation Ltd.) — plastic jars, bottles, drums, industrial containers serving paint & coatings, personal care, construction, chemicals, lubricants, food & beverages, home care, etc.
Specialty Chemicals Trading
Personal Care Formulation Products
Food & Nutrition
Insurance
Stock Info: Hitech Corporation Limited is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange, code BSE: 526217, and is a subsidiary of Geetanjali Trading and Investments Private Limited
Website: hitechgroup.com
Financials: Around USD 63 million revenue, roughly 423 employees (third-party data, may be outdated)
Also, there are several other companies in India called "Hitech / Hi-Tech," don’t mix them up:

Company Location Business
Hi-Tech (hitech.in) — equipment and engineering services for power and process industries in India since 1989
Hitech India Pvt Ltd (hitechconnector.com) Hyderabad, electrical/military connectors, 45 years old, supplier for India’s first nuclear submarine INS Arihant
Hitech India (hitechindia.net) Mumbai, post-press printing equipment
HiTech India (hitechindia.co.in) Coimbatore, UPVC/PVC door & window manufacturer and exporter
Hitech India Equipments Pvt Ltd — founded in 1990, industrial equipment
So, if you see a listed group in India doing plastic packaging, that’s Hitech Corporation Ltd (Mumbai, BSE 526217)

Kraft Lernen is a German company that specializes in supplying didactic and developmental materials for kindergartens, schools, and therapeutic institutions. Its product catalog includes educational aids, Montessori materials, board games, and supplies for motor skills, creative arts, and inclusive learning. Based in Germany, the company primarily targets educators, childcare professionals, and institutional procurement for educational centers.

SALEG (Sachsen-Anhaltische Landesentwicklungsgesellschaft mbH) is a state-owned land development company belonging to the German federal state of Saxony-Anhalt. The organization specializes in urban and regional planning, brownfield redevelopment, land resource management, and the support of infrastructure projects. It operates as a service partner for local municipalities, coordinating and implementing spatial development programs in the interests of the public sector.

https://www.mvsd11.org/
									The Meadows Valley School District strives to prepare all students for life's demands, adventures, and challenges. While the district offers educational services designed to foster student growth and development, its negligence in security has exposed its staff and students to the compromise of personal information. Therefore, we are providing you with confidential district documents, including student education records, protected health information, employee personnel files, Social Security numbers, payment card information, student lists, residential addresses, and phone numbers.

https://www.ridgway.k12.co.us/
									Ridgeway R-2 School District states its commitment to providing a safe and inclusive learning environment for students, however, their failure to secure your data and their failure to address this issue resulted in a breach of student and employee personal data (Social Security numbers, medical and disciplinary records) in violation of FERPA, the Colorado Student Data Transparency and Security Act (CRS 22-16-101 et seq.), the Colorado Data Breach Notification Act (CRS 6-1-716), CORA privacy exceptions, and possibly HIPAA.
